title: Coordinated Sniper Cohorts on Pump.fun: Detection of 1,012 Persistent Wallet Rings and a Contamination-Adjusted Estimate of Coordination-Specific First-Hour Buyer-Flow Lift
abstract: arXiv:2607.02795v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: CORRECTION (Oct 2026): buyer records include sells and miss many buys; all numerical results below are withdrawn pending a corrected analysis. Motivated by Kyle (1985) informed order flow and the Meiklejohn et al. (2013) wallet-clustering tradition, we ask whether persistent coordinated wallets causally raise first-hour buyer flow on the Solana pump.fun bonding-curve marketplace. Using 1,578,333 buyer observations from 166,098 launches over 13.4 days (2026-06-11 to 2026-06-25), a two-stage detection pipeline (intra-launch first-buyer-window extraction plus cross-launch persistent-cohort surfacing via union-find on co-occurrence graphs) identifies 1,012 persistent wallet cohorts (2 to 12 wallets, 2,965 addresses) that systematically co-fire as early buyers. tldr: 该论文提出两阶段检测流水线，在 Solana pump.fun 上识别出 1,012 个持续协同狙击的钱包团伙，并通过污染调整的倾向得分匹配方法估计这些协同行为对代币发行首小时买家流量的因果提升效应（注：作者已声明因数据问题撤回全部数值结果）。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a two-stage detection pipeline that identifies 1,012 persistent coordinated sniper wallet cohorts on Solana's pump.fun and uses a contamination-adjusted propensity-score matching estimator to causally quantify their first-hour buyer-flow lift (note: all numerical results have been withdrawn by the authors due to data issues).
